description: A/B of delegation: arm with (plugin) vs arm delegate (plugin + instruction to delegate to the ct-* subagents). Six single tasks from earlier rounds (four wide searches, two bug fixes) and two long-session cases that bundle several bug reports in one prompt, where the main context grows.

cases.prompt: Answer from the code in this repository, without modifying any file. List every method outside the test project that calls DateTimeUtils.EnsureDateTime. Write each one as Class.Method, one per line, and nothing else.

Answer from the code in this repository, without modifying any file. Which methods of StringUtils throw IllegalArgumentException("Strings must not be null")? Treat overloads as separate methods: write each one with its parameter list, one per line, and nothing else.

Answer from the code in this repository, without modifying any file. Which functions or methods under src/requests call to_native_string? Write each one as Class.method (or just the function name when it is not in a class), one per line, and nothing else.
Answer from the code in this repository, without modifying any file. In classes/range.js, which functions call isX? Write each function name, one per line, and nothing else.

A user reports: semver.maxSatisfying(['1.2.3', '1.2.4', '1.3.0'], '^1.2.0') returns '1.2.3' instead of '1.3.0'. Find the cause in this repository and fix it with a minimal change. Do not change the tests.

A user reports: merge keys stopped working. yaml.load('base: &b {a: 1, b: 2}
x:
  <<: *b
  c: 3
').x returns { c: 3 } instead of { a: 1, b: 2, c: 3 }. Find the cause in this repository and fix it with a minimal change. Do not change the tests.

Three bug reports arrived for this repository today. Handle them one after another, as in a normal work session.

1. A user reports: semver.maxSatisfying(['1.2.3', '1.2.4', '1.3.0'], '^1.2.0') returns '1.2.3' instead of '1.3.0'.
2. A user reports: semver.satisfies('0.3.0', '^0.2.3') returns true, but a caret range on a 0.x version must not allow a minor bump (^0.2.3 means >=0.2.3 <0.3.0-0).
3. A user reports: semver.inc('1.2.0-5', 'patch') returns '1.2.1', but incrementing the patch of a prerelease should release that patch and return '1.2.0'.

Fix each one in this repository with a minimal change. Do not change the tests. When all are fixed, say in one line per report which file and function you changed.
